# A cooperative two-A fast-connector recurrence construction

1 November 2026. Solo mathematical construction and review. **No independent
audit, external novelty clearance, physical validation or mission success is
claimed.** This file depends on the detailed local derivation in
`COOPERATIVE_LOCAL_PROOF.md`, not on inheriting the accepted one-A theorem.

## Statement

Take the finite fixed graph and fixed positive rates in the local proof. Put
q=m+1, m>=3. Attach the same qB catalyst to every fast composition complex,
and add the directed connector cycle

    0 -> A+B -> mA+qB -> 0,

with arbitrary fixed positive rates k_I,k_T,k_D. The composition graph is
strongly connected, contains mA and every 2A+(m-2)X_i, every complex contains
at least 2A, and every latter source has an A-increasing edge.

The construction below yields nonexplosion from every integer state, positive
recurrence of each communicating class, and every exponential invariant moment
of S=N+B. Constants are not uniform in dimension, graph, degree or rates.
This is a restricted structural family, not general weakly reversible recurrence.
The extension to minimum A>=3 or arbitrary connector geometry is NOT proved.

## 1. Nonexplosion is independent of the stopping constructions

Fast jumps conserve S. The connector gives

    L(1+S) <= C + C AB - c(A)_m(B)_q <= C'(1+S).

If A<m or B<q, AB is at most a constant times S. On the complementary
quadrant, fixed falling-factorial lower bounds show that the negative product
dominates AB outside a bounded A/B region. Finite-sublevel stopped Dynkin
and Gronwall therefore exclude finite-time escape. Each finite set has bounded
total rate, so the full process is nonexplosive. Large hidden pools cause no
problem in this argument because their fast jumps conserve S.

## 2. Exact geometry and the two inactive faces

Let nu=m-1 and a=nu/m<1. Set H(0)=0. For B=um+v with 1<=v<=m, put

    H(B)=u(m-1)+v,       r=N-H(B).

Then 0<=H(B)-aB<=1. Activation is r-neutral; immigration raises r by one
only at positive B divisible by m; clearing lowers r by one only at
B>=2q-1 congruent to 1 modulo m. All other r changes are zero. In particular
N>=r and, at B=q, N=r+m. From B=2q-1 the first clearing before immigration
is down-r, regardless of intervening activations. These identities use actual

1 November 2026. Solo derivation. This is mathematical mass-action theory,
not operational chemistry. No independent review or novelty clearance is claimed.
The accepted Astra pure-source and one-A catalytic theorems remain accepted at
their exact scope. The present hypothesis requires **two** A in every fast
complex and explicitly permits both unbounded inactive faces A=0 and A=1.

## Contract

Fix d>=2, m>=3, and a finite homogeneous conservative reaction graph on
composition species A,X_1,...,X_(d-1). Every complex has total degree m and
contains at least 2A. The graph contains mA and each 2A+(m-2)X_i. At every
latter complex there is a positive-rate edge increasing A. For the global
application the graph is strongly connected. All coefficients are fixed and
strictly positive. Constants below may depend on this whole finite object.

Write N=A+sum X_i and Q_N for its exact falling-factorial generator. For large
N restrict to A>=2. This set is fast-invariant. Kill at

    d(A)+u+vA,    d(A)=k_D (A)_m,

where k_D>0 is fixed and u,v range over a fixed compact nonnegative box. The
terminal event D is the actual d-channel; its physical post-clearing A is A-m.
Let R be the killed Green operator, T=R1, U=RA, and K_D its marked output
subkernel. No stationary distribution, mixing time or existing return time is
used. Q_N has a finite state space at each N.

## 1. Low-A drift of inverse powers

For every fixed j>=1 put g_j(a)=(1+a)^(-j). A bounded A jump changes g_j by
at most C_j g_j(a)/a on A>=2; the target also has A>=2. A decreasing A jump
must have at least 3 source A, because its product retains 2. Its total positive
contribution to Q_N g_j is at most

    C_j A^(2-j) N^(m-3).

When 2<=A<=eta N, some X_i>=cN. The required edge from 2A+(m-2)X_i then has
rate at least c A^2 N^(m-2), and decreases g_j by at least c_j A^(-j-1).
Other A-increasing edges help. Choose eta>0 sufficiently small (separately
for a finite list of j when necessary). Uniformly on this region,

    Q_N g_j <= -c_j N^(m-2) A g_j.                 (1)

Every source has at least 2A, so globally the absolute drift is bounded by
C_j N^(m-2) A g_j. On A>=eta N this is O(N^(m-j-1)), whereas d g_j is

1 November 2026. This is the author's own substantive review of the written
construction. It is NOT an independent whole-proof audit and does not inherit
any accepted Astra receipt. Source and code hashes bind versions, not correctness.

The two-A local derivation was rechecked using actual falling factorials, bounded
A jumps, a negative inverse-power drift at A<=eta N, and killing domination at
A>=eta N. Each negative A jump requires at least three source A. This is why its
adverse drift is one power of A/N smaller than the required two-A birth source.
The time bound is earned by stopped Dynkin, before any finite absorption mean is
assumed. The logarithmic occupation lower bound sums disjoint mesoscopic band
intervals and uses only conditional pointwise jump/hazard bounds, not independent
survival events. The large-input ratio is extended by an actual hitting stop.

The clearing envelope was rechecked with its real A-m output and the positive
forcing term in the killed Poisson inequality. The activation profile estimate
uses the actual A*g_j occupation, rather than multiplying an unweighted activation
probability by an observed reset. This relative norm is what makes arbitrarily
many extra high-phase activations summable despite repeated ordinary clearing.
